'''[[Kobbeth]]''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. He was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The sergeant's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] and son, [[Trea Kobbeth|Trea]] and [[Viyo Kobbeth]], lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], as part of the [[Pilgrims]] who inhabited [[Kalikori village]]. While searching Rakata vaults, Kobbeth encountered an individual associated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, who saved him and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Rand (corporal)|Rand]] from an [[Esh-kha]] assault. Rand attempted inform the Imperial of a vault key so that he and Kobbeth could be spared.<ref name="TOR" />

Kobbeth was the husband of the [[Pilgrims|Twi'lek Pilgrim]] [[Trea Kobbeth]] and father to [[Viyo Kobbeth]].<ref name="Mail" />
